title: Do your dream malls slowly evolve over time, so when you go back they suddenly look different?
content: I’ve noticed something for a long time about my dream world, especially the ‘mall world’ that I keep going back to. It isn’t static. Things slowly change and develop over time, almost like a real place that exists on its own timeline. It isn’t like constant renovation, more like gradual evolution. So if I don’t visit for a while, I come back and suddenly realise just how much has changed. This most recently happened in a dream I had in Jan 2026. There used to be a big area of the mall filled with food vendors - Japanese stalls, world food, international small markets stands, tucked into corners - really vibrant and busy. But this time, it had been modernised. Sleeker, more corporate, and majorly disappointing, it took me awhile to recognise. There were a few modernised vendor stands dotted about now, but each with OTT branding, neon signs/lights etc. There was still a large otaku-style independent markets area tucked away in one corner that hadn’t changed yet… but it felt like it would eventually. And the staircases and escalators. Somehow even more confusing than before, making some shops almost impossible to get to. But this isn’t a one-off thing. I’ve noticed it across other locations in my dream world, and even in the way storylines and relationships progress over time. It’s like everything continues existing in the background between dreams. Does anyone else experience this?
